v.q: What does declarative UI mean in React?
o: Describe the UI for the current state
Update each DOM node by hand
v.w: You describe what it should look like and React works out the DOM changes.

o: An HTML string for the DOM
Real DOM nodes built at once
v.w: JSX is a description, not HTML and not a string.

v.q: Which is read-only for the component that receives it?
v.w: A component never changes its props. A parent passes a callback instead.

v.q: What happens when you call a state setter?
v.w: The new value shows in the next render, not on the next line.

v.q: Why must state not be mutated?
v.w: The same reference looks unchanged, so the render may be skipped.

v.q: How do you add an item to array state?
v.w: Create a new array so React sees a new reference.

v.q: What does setCount(count + 1) three times in one handler give?
v.w: All three calls use the same snapshot of count.

v.q: Which form adds 3 with three calls?
v.w: The updater form receives the latest queued value each time.

o: Its state or its parent changes
v.w: Context changes also trigger it, and memo can skip it for equal props.

v.q: What must the render phase be?
v.w: No side effects, because React can pause, repeat or discard a render.

v.q: What is the best key for a list item?
o: A stable id from the data
v.w: Index keys break when items are inserted or reordered.

v.q: What does changing a component key do?
v.w: React unmounts the old one and mounts a new one.

o: Its value lives in the DOM
v.w: State is the single source of truth, updated in onChange.

v.q: Which is correct for a click handler?
v.w: Calling the function in JSX runs it during render.

v.q: How does React favour reuse over inheritance?
v.w: A Card renders children, and shared logic goes into custom hooks.

v.q: Why call hooks only at the top level?
o: React tracks state by call order
It is only a style rule
v.w: A hook inside a condition shifts the order and mixes up the state.
